sourceText: Operator standing order (2026-07-03, translated from Chinese chat): why are you asking me to choose — follow the plan order and complete all remaining milestones to DONE. M1 (fixture generator) is next after B-047f merged S1 (M0+M2+M5).
normalizedOutcome: A deterministic trap-fixture generator exists on main under experiments/experience-ablation/ (fixture-generator.mjs + trap-templates.mjs + fixture-generator-selfcheck.mjs): same seed emits a byte-identical corpus covering the plan S5.1 six in-store classes, held-out negative-controls, and clean tasks; every fixture carries a leakage-stripped workspace (plan S9), a hidden S6.1 oracle validated in both directions against reference overlays, and a manifest that feeds the S1 pair ledger end-to-end.
acceptanceClaim: node experiments/experience-ablation/fixture-generator-selfcheck.mjs exits 0 on the story branch with all cases passing, including: same-seed double-emission byte-diff empty; in-store roster equal to the plan six with held-out disjointness; zero leakage-marker hits across every emitted workspace and prompt; every oracle clean on reference-good and firing the class-appropriate flag on reference-bad; and the emitted manifest building + verifying through the real pair-ledger.mjs against a frozen protocol.
